title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: WHO has been informed of an additional four laboratory-confirmed cases of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection in Saudi Arabia.

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: WHO has been informed of an additional two laboratory-confirmed cases of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection in Qatar.

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: WHO has been informed of an additional eight laboratory-confirmed cases of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection in Saudi Arabia.

title: Poliovirus detected from environmental samples in Israel - update
summary: WHO estimates the risk of further international spread of wild poliovirus type 1 (WPV1) from Israel to remain moderate to high. This risk assessment reflects evidence of increasing geographic extent of circulation over a prolonged period of time

title: Human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus – update
summary: The National Health and Family Planning Commission, China notified WHO of a new laboratory-confirmed case of human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus. This is the first new confirmed case of human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus since 20 July 2013

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: WHO has been informed of an additional three laboratory-confirmed cases of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection in Saudi Arabia.
